title: Scenic and Wild Guided Kayak Tour for 2 people
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
SCENIC AND WILD GUIDED KAYAK TOUR FOR TWO PEOPLE (1 DOUBLE/TANDEM KAYAK INCLUDED) SEATS TWO PEOPLE *** FOR SINGLE KAYAK BOOKINGS PLEASE USE OUR OTHER LISTING. 
Discover the stunning landscapes of Lake Tahoe on a guided kayak tour designed for two. Paddle from El Dorado Beach, gliding over crystal-clear waters while our knowledgeable guides share captivating stories about the lake and its landmarks. This tour offers a unique chance to view the natural beauty of Lake Tahoe from both California and Nevada sides, enhancing your experience. Perfect for couples or friends looking to bond while exploring the great outdoors.

- Paddle a tandem kayak from El Dorado Beach at 9:30 am
- Learn about Lake Tahoe's history and landmarks from expert guides
- Enjoy views of wildlife and the Upper Truckee River
- Return to Lakeview Commons by 12:00pm for a memorable morning
